messages:
zoe (DevEx): Heads-up: our unit tests started failing in CI after the SDK went ESM-first. Local (node18) is fine, GH Actions mac/node16 throws "Unexpected token 'export'" or "does not provide an export named 'default'" for node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.mjs. Anyone seen this exact CI vs local split?

mike (SDK): Yup — hitting this during our internal QA. We published ESM .mjs and a CJS .cjs plus an exports map. Usually that works, but some runners end up trying to load the raw .mjs with require() and explode. What's your jest/vitest config?

zoe (DevEx): Jest config (example-app):
```
module.exports = {
  preset: 'ts-jest',
  testEnvironment: 'node',
  transformIgnorePatterns: ['/node_modules/']
}
```
Vitest is run with deps.inline: ['@redwood/inference-js'] in vitest.config.ts.

pablo (Eng): Two different layers: (A) Jest (CJS) will often try to require/transform node_modules; transformIgnorePatterns by default skips them, so raw .mjs files cause the SyntaxError. (B) Even if you inline/transform, different transformers (ts-jest vs swc vs esbuild) treat top-level ESM differently. CI image/node version differences amplify this.

rachel (QA): We also saw flaky snapshot failures where the exported client shape differs (sometimes default exists, sometimes only named exports). That suggests module interop differences between runners.

mike (SDK): Short-term mitigations we've used: 1) add a tiny CJS shim at package root (index.cjs) that does `module.exports = require('./dist/index.cjs')` so older toolchains can require() cleanly. 2) In Jest, whitelist the package for transformation: `transformIgnorePatterns: ['/node_modules/(?!(?:@redwood/inference-js)/)']` and add a transformer for .mjs (eg. `@swc/jest` or `esbuild-jest`). 3) For Vitest, ensure `deps.inline: ['@redwood/inference-js']` and set `esbuild.target: 'es2020'` so esbuild doesn't emit CJS shims.

zoe (DevEx): Tried whitelisting but then ts-jest + swc mismatch caused `Cannot use import statement outside a module` in some transitive deps. Transformers are messy. Also we have auth mocks that import webcrypto; node16 CI doesn't have globalThis.crypto which causes additional failures.

pablo (Eng): For webcrypto: add a setup file for Jest and Vitest that polyfills webcrypto/fetch. Example (setupTests.js):
```
// setupTests.js
const { webcrypto } = require('node:crypto')
globalThis.crypto = webcrypto
globalThis.fetch = require('node-fetch')
```
Add to jest config `setupFilesAfterEnv: ['./test/setupTests.js']` and vitest `setupFiles: ['./test/setupTests.js']`.

rachel (QA): For mocking auth flows, manual mocks are less brittle. Put `__mocks__/@redwood/inference-js.js` with the exported shape you need — jest picks that up automatically. For Vitest, use `vi.mock('@redwood/inference-js', async () => ({ createClient: () => ({}) }))`. Avoid mocking deep internal paths like `dist/auth` — those break with ESM renames.

mike (SDK): Long-term: we'll add the CJS shim + a small index.mjs that re-exports default + named to guarantee both patterns work: `export { default } from './dist/runtime.mjs'; export * from './dist/runtime.mjs'`. Also update package.json exports to explicitly point import/require. I'll open a patch (RED-7890) today.

zoe (DevEx): Short-term we added a test shim in setupTests to normalize the imported module shape: after import we do `if (sdk && !('default' in sdk)) sdk.default = sdk.createClient || (() => {})`. Ugly but stabilizes CI snapshots.

ci-bot: CI: unit-tests (macOS, node16) #128 failed on first run, re-run queued.

rachel (QA): After the shim + polyfills, mac/node16 passed 8/10 times locally. I'll rerun 20 iterations in CI after the SDK patch. If flakes remain, we'll add a smoke test in SDK CI that runs `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/inference-js'))"` on node16 to catch resolver changes.

pablo (Eng): Note for maintainers: avoid publishing builds where only named exports exist without also shipping default re-export, or call out clearly in README that default import is not supported. Tests and downstream apps are fragile.

mike (SDK): PR opened: #821 adds index.cjs shim, index.mjs re-export, and updates exports map. Pushing a patch release now. Please ping here when you verify.

zoe (DevEx): Verified PR #821 patch: CI mac/node16 job now consistently passes in our matrix. Filing follow-up doc PR with recommended jest/vitest snippets and a short checklist for SDK authors: publish CJS shim, include re-export default, include types, and add a compatibility smoke test.

ci-bot: CI job #128 re-run succeeded :rocket:

zoe (DevEx): Thanks all. If anyone else hits ESM/CJS test breakage, paste failing stack + package.json + jest/vitest config here and we'll triage.
